subject: Strategic demo: finalizing exec intro timing and coverage

From: Alex Kramer <alex.kramer@orionlogic.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood demo request — exec intro requested

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking the time to talk last week. We’re interested in a targeted demo that includes a short executive intro with our CIO (Martin Hale) and one of our VPs for platform strategy. High-level ask: 30 minutes of CIO-level context followed by a 45-minute technical demo & Q&A.

Our constraints: Martin is only available in the late-morning PT window the week of May 25-29. VP availability is TBD and likely limited. Can you propose a 90-minute block (or a split: 30-min exec + 45-min demo) plus a 20-30 minute pre-demo prep with your presenter? We’re aiming to keep the exec time tightly scoped to platform fit and SLA/controls.

Attached: Orion_RFP_tl_dr.pdf (overview).

Attendees on our side: Martin Hale (CIO), Priya Suresh (Director of Cloud Engineering), and a procurement rep.

Best,
Alex
Alex Kramer
VP, Strategic Accounts
Orion Logic

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Redwood demo request — exec intro requested

Alex,

Thanks — we can absolutely structure the session that way. Proposed options (PT):
- Option A: Tue May 26 — 11:30am3:00pm (30-min exec intro at 11:30, demo 12:003:00)
- Option B: Wed May 27 — 3:00pm4:30pm (exec intro 3:00, demo 3:304:15)

If Martin can only spare 30 minutes, we can do a tight 30-min exec intro + 45-min demo afterwards. For continuity, I recommend a 20-minute prep with our presenter and your sponsor ~30-45 minutes before the exec intro to align on success criteria and any redlines.

Who would you like included from Redwood on the exec intro? My proposal: one of our senior product leads (Aditya Rao) for the exec overview and me to handle alignment/logistics. Laura can join for procurement/contract Qs.

Draft agenda attached: demo-agenda-draft.pdf. Please confirm preferred option and attendee list.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

- Sophia (me): coordinate calendar invites and run the pre-demo 20-minute sync with Orion sponsor + our presenter.

I’m going to propose blocking May 26 11:0011:30 PT for a short prep and hold the 11:302:15 PT slot as tentative exec+demo. I will wait for confirmation from Alex and then send calendar invites (ICS).
